scheme_name: Chief Minister's Jeevan Jyoti Swaniyojan Yojana
other_conditions: Minimum educational qualification up to 10th standard; for women in handloom and sericulture activities the qualification is relaxed to Class V; for male youth in agricultural and animal husbandry activities the qualification is relaxable to Class VII

Implemented on a group basis with a minimum of four members forming a Joint Liability Swabalambi Group; individual applicants and two‑member groups with a joint account are also eligible for certain activities such as computer training/DTP centers
benefits_summary: Provides self‑employment opportunities with institutional credit and up to 50% margin‑money subsidy for eligible youth in Assam.
